messages:
jamie: FYI customer Ledgerly escalated — after yesterday's model bump to redwood-instruct-v11 they're seeing long-form help summaries become noticeably curt and less explanatory.
kevin: Can you paste a short before/after example?
jamie: Yep.
jamie: API used: ```POST /v1/generate\n{\n  \"model\": \"redwood-instruct-v11\",\n  \"input\": \"Summarize the onboarding flow for merchants in plain language. Include common pitfalls and recommended next steps.\",\n  \"max_tokens\": 400,\n  \"temperature\": 0.2\n}```
jamie: Customer provided these outputs.
jamie: BEFORE (v10.4): \"Welcome! To get started as a merchant, first sign up and verify your email. After verification, connect your bank account — this usually takes 1-2 business days. Common issues include mismatched account names; if that happens, double-check the account holder details. Next, set up your payout schedule and test a sandbox transaction. Recommended next step: complete the two-step verification and run a sandbox payment to confirm settings. If you see an error, contact support with your merchant ID and the transaction trace.\"
jamie: AFTER (v11): \"Sign up, verify email, link bank, run a test. If bank name mismatch, check details. Enable 2FA. Contact support if you get errors.\"
kevin: I can see the tone trimmed and fewer helpful scaffolding sentences. Any errors or different headers in the request?
jamie: No errors. They repro'd on both hosted API and on Dedicated; consistent shorter replies. No change to the customer prompt templates.
maria-ml: Do we know when v11 was promoted to prod for Ledgerly's tenant?
support-bot: Canary promotion log: model redwood-instruct-v11 promoted to prod at 3188801000. No rollback events recorded.
jen-sre: Need request IDs and traces for a couple of examples to correlate with infra changes.
jamie: Provided request ids: req_0a12, req_0a13. Also included a small SDK snippet and a deterministic seed used by the customer.
jamie: Repro steps customer used: 1) call above POST 2) set `max_tokens=400` 3) set `temperature=0.2` 4) run 10 samples previously and 10 now, all deterministic.
maria-ml: Quick signal: internal eval across 5k summary prompts shows average token count dropped ~28% on v11 for long-form summarization templates. Human eval shows higher factual precision but lower helpfulness/empathetic phrasing.
kevin: Did v11 include quantization changes or any system-prompt fallback logic changes?
jamie: Ops noted v11 rollout included int8 quant kernel path and a scheduling tweak for prefix caching (change merged by infra on 3188795000). No prompt template modifications.
eng-ml-bot: INF-3421 created: \"v11 summarization brevity regression\". Assigned to eng-ml.
maria-ml: I'll run controlled A/B locally: v10.4 vs v11 with identical seeds and collect token lengths, perplexity, and a small human rating sample for \"helpfulness\".
kevin: Short-term workaround: tell Ledgerly to pin model to v10.4 or prepend system instruction: \"You are a friendly customer success writer. Provide detailed, step-by-step explanations and examples.\" That should nudge verbosity back.
jamie: I'll share the workaround and ask for permission to pin them to v10.4. They need an ETA though.
jen-sre: Also check the routing policy — if requests were routed to a lighter variant of v11 on certain regions that might prioritize brevity for latency.
maria-ml: Noted. I'm also going to experiment with quantized vs non-quantized runtime to see if token generation distribution changes with int8 kernels.
kevin: Thanks. Can eng-ml please prioritise a quick triage and report within 24h — customer uses these summaries in their onboarding UI so it's high priority.
eng-ml-bot: Acknowledged. Triage in progress. Will update INF-3421 with initial findings.
jamie: Customer asked if we can provide a temporary patch: either pin or a server-side instruction rewrite. I'm going to send the pin workaround now.
kevin: Good. Add the request ids and customer repro notes to INF-3421.
jamie: Done. I'll follow up here once customer confirms workaround results. :eyes:
